title: Formal assembly of strict Kummer transport and finite class normalization
statement: Let A,B,C_n be abelian categories with small Ext groups in a fixed universe and chosen derived categories for A and strict B-systems. Let L be left adjoint to U, and D a simultaneous derived reduction [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface]. Fix exact additive F_n:C_n to B and V_n:C_n to A, objects S,M,Q_n,P_n, a boundary delta in Ext^1(S,M), generator maps g_n, Kummer classes kappa_n and roots tower R. Suppose the canonically normalized source counit a is invertible, source isomorphisms satisfying a specified sourceNorm predicate and the normalized generator equation exist, and a single strict Kummer target satisfies KummerArrowTransport [lem-sfb-kummer-strict-target-transport] and the specified roots normalization. Let finiteClass be any predicate on finite Ext^2 classes. Suppose its value on the restriction F_n(e) holds whenever e has scalar adjunct minus delta followed by kappa_n. Then normalizedBoundaryTarget holds for finiteClass and these fixed data.

source.place: Formal assembly of the normalized source, strict target, and finite Cartier class comparison in steps (3)--(4).

proof.text: Unpack the single strict target data and, at each level, its target isomorphism and a source isomorphism with both its sourceNorm predicate and its normalized generator equation. Keep the same H, roots and b.

Unfold the arbitrary-arrow transport formula and apply it to the fixed source counit, source generator, and delta. It gives a residue-linear e, its scalar-adjunct equation and the equality of its exact restriction with the evaluated strict arrow.

Apply the assumed finite-class implication to the scalar-adjunct equation. Substitute the transport evaluation equality into this predicate. This supplies the finite-class component and retains both level normalizations and the same strict-system data.

theorem kummer_transport_assembly
    (ℓ : ℕ) {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [abA : Abelian A] [hA : HasExt.{w} A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [abB : Abelian B] [hB : HasExt.{w} B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B)]
    [HasExt.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B)]
    (L : A ⥤ B) (U : B ⥤ A) (ad : L ⊣ U) (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ L)
    (C : ℕ → Type uC) [catC : ∀ n, Category.{vC} (C n)] [abC : ∀ n, Abelian (C n)]
    [hC : ∀ n, HasExt.{w} (C n)]
    (F : ∀ n, C n ⥤ B) [Fadd : ∀ n, (F n).Additive]
    [Flim : ∀ n, PreservesFiniteLimits (F n)]
    [Fcolim : ∀ n, PreservesFiniteColimits (F n)]
    (V : ∀ n, C n ⥤ A) [Vadd : ∀ n, (V n).Additive]
    [Vlim : ∀ n, PreservesFiniteLimits (V n)]
    [Vcolim : ∀ n, PreservesFiniteColimits (V n)]
    (S M : A) (δ : Ext S M 1) (rootsTower : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A)
    (Q P : ∀ n, C n) (g : ∀ n, S ⟶ (V n).obj (Q n))
    (κ : ∀ n, Ext M ((V n).obj (P n)) 1)
    {sourceNorm : ∀ n, ((D.ordinary.E.obj S).obj (op n) ≅ (F n).obj (Q n)) → Prop}
    {finiteClass : ∀ n, Ext ((F n).obj (Q n)) ((F n).obj (P n)) 2 → Prop}
    {rootNorm : ∀ H : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B, (H ⋙ U ≅ rootsTower) →
      ∀ n, (H.obj (op n) ≅ (F n).obj (P n)) → Prop}
    (a : D.T.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj S) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (D.ordinary.E.obj S))
    (ha : a.hom = diagonalDerivedSingleCounit ℓ L D S)
    (hs : ∀ n, ∃ s : (D.ordinary.E.obj S).obj (op n) ≅ (F n).obj (Q n),
      sourceNorm n s)
    (hg : ∀ n s, sourceNorm n s →
      HEq (ad.unit.app S ≫ U.map ((D.ordinary.π n).app S ≫ s.hom)) (g n))
    (ht : Nonempty (KummerTargetData ℓ L U ad D C F V M rootsTower P κ rootNorm))
    (hc : ∀ n (e : Ext (Q n) (P n) 2),
      kummerScalarAdjunct (V n) (g n) e =
        negativeExtProduct δ (κ n) → finiteClass n (exactFunctorExtImage (F n) e)) :
    normalizedBoundaryTarget ℓ L U D S M δ rootsTower
      (fun n => (F n).obj (Q n)) (fun n => (F n).obj (P n))
      sourceNorm rootNorm finiteClass a
